subject: Intro walkthrough & success criteria — next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.m@clearline.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Intro walkthrough & success criteria — next steps

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap from my side and a suggested next step to keep momentum:

Summary (two bullets):
- Primary outcomes you’re looking for: lower per-token inference cost on chat-heavy workflows, sub-150ms 95th-percentile latency for short queries, and configurable tenant isolation for PHI-sensitive workloads.
- Key internal stakeholders you mentioned: yourself (Product), Samir (Engineering lead), and Priya (Security/compliance).

Proposed next step: 30-minute product walkthrough focused on the actual runtime behavior (latency, batching, and caching), integration touchpoints (SSO, data flows), and a short Q&A with a solutions engineer.

Please pick one of these 30-minute windows that works best for your group:
1) Tue, Nov 12 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Tue, Nov 12 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
(If neither works, Wed, Nov 13 morning is also possible — happy to propose specific times.)

Proposed agenda (30m):
- 5m: introductions & goals
- 10m: live run of a small inference flow (latency + cost tradeoffs)
- 10m: integration & security touchpoints (SSO, logging, retention)
- 5m: next steps & success criteria (pilot/runbook)

Attachment: I’ve attached a short agenda and a one-sheet that lists the success criteria we typically track for pilots. If you can forward any existing SSO or compliance checklist beforehand, our SE can prepare targeted materials.

Link to quickly confirm a slot: https://cal.redwood.com/neha/30min?cid=DEAL-9483

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
